# E0401: a lens's lacunas are not listed unconditionally

A lens lists every lacuna it can emit unconditionally; each lacuna's own
condition field decides whether it applies to an instance. A list built with a
comprehension has no known length until data arrives, so the lacunas cannot be
checked.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				a:  string
				b?: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.1->0.0": {
		v0_1: _
		v0_0: {
			a: v0_1.a
		}
		lacunas: [
			if v0_1.b != _|_ {
				{type: "DroppedField", message: "b was dropped"}
			},
		]
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0401]: the lacunas of lens 0.1->0.0 are not listed unconditionally
  --> lineage.cue:23:3
   |
23 |         lacunas: [
   |         ^^^^^^^
   |
   = help: list every lacuna the lens can emit; each lacuna's condition field decides whether it applies
```
